Gym 0.1.15 · Hotel 0.1.15 · Jewellery 0.1.15 · Library 0.1.18 · Shop 1.3.18

- CSP-safe saved-theme startup restores the chosen theme without allowing inline scripts.
- Premium theme-aware login: six locally bundled architectural artworks, clear form surfaces, compact branding, 44px controls and responsive layouts. Shop keeps its existing five selectable themes.
- Improved Ice White and White text contrast, consistent typography and controls, semantic Library/Jewellery status colors, and refined settings, booking and workspace presentation.
- Includes the current booking wizard, compact booking-summary and Hotel guest-detail improvements from the latest source.
- Includes licence startup/upgrade handling fixes and the latest activation/update dialog styling. Internet interruptions do not independently expire a valid licence or reset business data.
- Update notices use the installed version; What's new is presented after sign-in for an installed update, without repeating for the same version.
- Existing application identity, customer records, local accounts, licence dates and backup locations are preserved by the upgrade path. The updater creates a verified safety backup before installation.

Four separate installer profiles per product: Windows 10/11 x64, Windows 10 x86, Windows 7 SP1 x64 and Windows 7 SP1 x86. Release metadata is signed for the existing verified update channel."}
